source.live: NOT_ACQUIRED: no live source run exists in this build

gates.effect: A live host starts with REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE: /health/live is 200, /health/ready is 503, nothing is stored and pipeline steps stop with typed unavailability.
gates.missing: FOCUS_FN migrations 001-009 are not installed on any SQL Server.
gates.resolve: A DBA with DDL rights re-runs queries/discovery/fn_collisions.sql, then applies the reviewed bundle with `migrate --apply --catalog live --installer <subject> --confirm-manifest <sha256>`.

gates.effect: Even with the schema installed, live storage stays REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE.
gates.missing: The mapping of the repository protocol onto the FOCUS_FN tables is not built; focus/data/sql_store.py refuses every write.
gates.resolve: Engineering builds the adapter and verifies it against an installed non-production database.

gates.effect: No live process holds its role's permissions; the separation of duties exists only as a reviewed script.
gates.missing: sql/grants/focus_fn_roles.sql is generated and linted but not applied, and no login is mapped to a role.
gates.resolve: A DBA applies the grants after 001-009 and maps one login per process (web, source, stager, signer, evaluator).

gates.effect: Live publication refuses, so there is no executable acceptance and no executable dispatch.
gates.missing: No production signing key or FOCUS_SIGN_KEY_REF exists; only the fixture TEST key is present.
gates.resolve: The security owner provisions the key, referenced only in the signer's environment.

gates.effect: An executable live release cannot be claimed; only the fixture rehearsal of the same protocol exists.
gates.missing: The live stage, readback, validation and accept sequence has never run against SQL Server.
gates.resolve: Rehearse on a non-production database once LG-01 to LG-04 are resolved, and keep the receipts.

gates.effect: Live snapshots have no executable crews; jobs that depend on an open semantic are blocked or conditional with typed reasons.
gates.missing: PERSON_TEAM_MAP and ATTENDANCE_SHIFT were empty when the manual observed them (OD-10), and OD-01 to OD-14 have fixture choices only.
gates.resolve: Source owners populate the feeds and record decisions OD-01 to OD-14 in the policy.

gates.effect: The evaluator refuses live (LIVE_OBSERVATIONS_UNAVAILABLE), so there are no live scores, points or XP.
gates.missing: OD-15: no approved producer writes lifecycle events, actual intervals, claims or decisions.
gates.resolve: Approve and install the producers, granted FOCUS_FN_ObservationProducer.

gates.effect: Every evaluation is labeled demonstration and personal grades stay disabled.
gates.missing: OD-16: score.policy_status is DEMONSTRATION with no approval reference.
gates.resolve: The policy owner approves the score policy and records score.policy_approval_ref.

gates.effect: Claims can be filed, but no live decision can be recorded, so no relief is applied.
gates.missing: OD-17: no reviewer identity is mapped to the excusal_decider role on a live host.
gates.resolve: The operations owner names the reviewers in FOCUS_GRANTS_JSON.

gates.effect: Every scoped read and command refuses with UNAUTHENTICATED or FORBIDDEN; only health and the landing page answer.
gates.missing: FOCUS_GRANTS_JSON and the identity provider settings are not configured on any host (the Posit Connect credentials header, or the Tanzu trusted header).
gates.resolve: The platform administrator configures the identity provider and the server-owned grants per host.

gates.missing: Nothing was deployed to Posit Connect or Tanzu by this build: the session held no environment authority.
gates.resolve: The platform owner deploys the reviewed commit (`rsconnect deploy api`, then `cf push`) after preflight passes.

gates.effect: A real release still needs an independent verdict on the same hashes.
gates.missing: Only implementer self-checks exist in review/; no independent reviewer has examined this build.
gates.resolve: An independent reviewer writes the next review/REVIEW-NNN.md and VERDICT-NNN.json against the bound hashes.

gates.effect: Pipeline roles have no scheduler; they run only by hand or as Tanzu tasks.
gates.missing: The GitLab CI draft was never pushed to a GitLab remote or activated; its protected environments and resource groups do not exist.
gates.resolve: The CI owner activates .gitlab-ci.yml with protected environments per role.

gates.effect: Plans come from the named heuristic alone, with the typed solver status DISABLED. Every rule is still enforced.
gates.missing: solver.enabled is false and FOCUS_SOLVER_ENABLED is unset; ortools is not in requirements.txt.
gates.resolve: The owner decides with SOLVER_ENABLEMENT.md and installs requirements-solver.txt.

gates.effect: Explanations are the complete deterministic ones; the schedule and ranking are unchanged.
gates.missing: OD-18: no BCAI endpoint, credential or response adapter is approved.
gates.resolve: Approve the provider and configure it; responses still pass the strict validators.

gates.effect: POST /mcp answers 404. When enabled, it is read-only and uses the same identity, grants and scope as REST; commands, signing and grading are never exposed over MCP.
gates.resolve: Set FOCUS_MCP_ENABLED=true on the host that serves application-to-application callers.

gates.effect: A term with any other curve is UNSUPPORTED: its line cost is never zero, it is listed as unknown, and no improvement is claimed from it.
gates.missing: Only the LINEAR_DAILY penalty curve is supported.
gates.resolve: Add the curve to the economics registry with its exact evaluator and tests.

scope.evidence: fixture only; live release is a separate capability (S21)

statement: This verdict is an implementer self-check, not an independent review. It binds the hashes above; a changed file needs a new review.
